title: Ford 3.5 EcoBoost F-150: cold-start rattle, P0016 timing chain wear, humid-weather stumble
summary: Three Ford bulletins for the 2011-2015 F-150 3.5L EcoBoost: VCT units and primary chain for a 2-5 second cold-start rattle, primary chain for P0016, and a stumble/misfire on hard acceleration in humid weather.

specs.name: Rattle symptom
specs.value: Tick/tap/rattle from top front cover area for 2-5 seconds at start-up after a cold soak of 6+ hours

specs.name: Rattle repair
specs.value: Replace all four VCT units and the primary timing chain (WSM section 303-01)

specs.name: P0016 test
specs.value: VCT_INT_ACT1 PID at +6 degrees or more (KOER) points to a worn primary chain

steps.text: Cold-start rattle: confirm the truck was built on or before 29-May-2015. Later builds: use normal diagnostics (WSM 303-00).
Confirm the noise matches: a tick, tap or rattle from the top front cover area lasting 2-5 seconds on start-up after sitting 6 hours or more.
If both match, replace all four VCT units and the primary timing chain per WSM 303-01.
P0016 with the MIL on: confirm P0016 is stored in the PCM and the truck was built on or before 10-Oct-2014.
With the engine running, watch the VCT_INT_ACT1 PID. At +6 degrees or more, replace the primary timing chain (WSM 303-01). Below +6 degrees, the bulletin does not apply.
Intermittent stumble or misfire on hard acceleration after extended highway driving in humid or damp weather is a separate condition with its own Ford bulletins.
